title: "Software Engineering" Is Not Engineering
summary: A philosophical critique questioning whether software development qualifies as true engineering, arguing it lacks the systematic methodologies, predictability, and established standards found in traditional engineering disciplines like civil or mechanical engineering.
problem_solved: Challenges the assumption that software development follows rigorous engineering principles comparable to traditional engineering fields.
why_valuable: Encourages critical reflection on the maturity and methodological rigor of software engineering as a professional discipline.
